a) a pre-trained building block for neural networks based on a mean-field description of a Boltzman machine can increase adversarial resistance, b) the adversarial resistance is strongly correlated with the generality performance of the Boltzman machine, c) this method is not only applicable to MNIST, but also to CIFAR10.

In summary, our research is concerned with
the question of how to improve the adversarial robustness of neural networks.
the question: Can we use the ability of a neural network to generate realistic data to improve its adversarial resistance?
the development of robust deep neural network architectures and the analysis of the relation between robustness and generative performance.

our approach can increase adversarial resistance without the need for adversarial training or data augmentation.
the method presented is a new and interesting way to improve the adversarial robustness of neural networks.
the generative pre-training of the neural network improves the robustness against adversarially crafted images.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we show that adversarial robustness and generation are two sides of the same coin.
adversarial resistance can be increased through a generative pre-training approach.
adversarial resistance and generative performance of deep neural networks can be improved through generative pre training.
The main takeaway from our work is that
adversarial attacks are not only relevant in the context of image recognition, but also for the more general problem of learning generative models.
generative pre-training can be a powerful tool to improve robustness to adversarial attacks.
generative pre-training of a neural network can be an alternative to data augmentation or adversarially trained models for improving adversarial resistance.
